support_claim: Commercial notes state that legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party and instruct to treat the registry link as unresolved, while billing uses "Northbridge Analytics Inc." and registry row 2019-0008841 lists "NORTHBRIDGE ANALYTICS LLC" without any bridging identity evidence.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and DISTINCT requires establishing evidence of distinctness; name similarity and compatible industry context are insufficient. The packet preserves multiple live candidates (billing Inc. versus registry LLC, with an additional Wyoming LLC noted in credit checks) and explicitly records that identity cannot be established, so neither positive nor negative disposition is licensed and UNRESOLVED is the correct outcome.
